question_selection.policy: Select the sole next_day_sample_sales finding only when a validated served_item relationship and exactly one validated operational sales layout support the same dynamic unit; otherwise return UNKNOWN.

normalization.aggregation: sum admitted finite record values within the exact committed entity/location/one-day cohort

prediction.target: next-day admitted sample sales greater than or equal to the discovery-derived arithmetic-mean threshold
prediction.cohort: tenant/company entity-location and one-day UTC window
prediction.commitment: durable before release of the matching future operational records

revision.rule: (1 + resolved positive development outcomes) / (2 + resolved development outcomes)

scoring.comparison: frozen prior and revised methods on identical resolved later cohorts, outcomes, evidence, units and horizons

experiment.claim: The frozen ORION learner can discover one supported operational relationship in an unfamiliar synthetic restaurant, commit prospective predictions, reconstruct later outcomes from admitted records, revise only from resolved evidence, and measure the revision honestly on subsequent unseen cohorts.
permitted_learner_inputs: separately authorized process, aggregate, temporal and relationship evidence
only the currently released bounded future operational records
forbidden_learner_inputs: future records before their release stage
experiment.semantic_support: Each accepted role must satisfy the frozen FNB rule with at least two independently rooted evidence sources and at least two subjects; relationship identity and target resource must be evidenced.
unknown_conditions: scope, provenance, horizon or cohort mismatch
experiment.missing_or_partial_outcome_treatment: Retain the prediction as pending and classify the evaluation as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; do not impute, drop, or score the case.
experiment.abstention_reporting: Report every UNKNOWN, its reason, whether any supported question was answered, and the evidence plus separate authorization needed next.

sample.limitations: Four cohorts can demonstrate ordering and arithmetic but cannot establish calibration, statistical significance, economic value or generalization.

learning_loop_integrity.pass: All four predictions are committed before release; admitted record provenance reconstructs every eligible outcome; the revision uses only the two resolved development outcomes; paired scoring uses the same later observations.
learning_loop_integrity.fail: Any chronological, commitment, provenance, revision-evidence or paired-scoring invariant is violated.
learning_loop_integrity.blocked: A conforming independently authored package or required authorization is unavailable.

semantic_understanding.supported_within_tested_scope: The frozen semantic rules support a unique useful relationship from admitted independently rooted evidence in the package.
semantic_understanding.unknown: The frozen engine abstains because evidence is insufficient or ambiguous.
semantic_understanding.not_proven: No independently authored package is executed.

predictive_improvement.demonstrated: The revised Brier score is strictly lower than the frozen baseline on both identical eligible later cohorts.
predictive_improvement.not_demonstrated: The revised Brier score is equal or higher.
predictive_improvement.insufficient_evidence: Fewer than two complete paired evaluation outcomes remain eligible.

criteria.revision_helped_later: Use only the registered paired Brier comparison; report improvement, equality, worsening or insufficient evidence without changing the fixture or metric.
criteria.economic_value: NOT_PROVEN unless a separately preregistered operational-value criterion and required evidence are supplied before outcome release.

required_authorship_evidence: source and prior ORION results visible before freezing
independent reviewer verification of those facts
independent_material.current_evidence: Existing F&B fixtures and the learning engine share repository authorship; no independently authored package or verified authorship record was found.

separation.boundary: Trusted local evaluator stages fixed JSON material and invokes existing governed adapters; learner inputs and persisted learner state exclude evaluator-only commitments and unreleased stages.
